columns.lat_x_m: commanded lateral start offset of the tip, x, POCKET frame, m
columns.start_height_m: commanded tip height above the entrance, pocket z, m
columns.yaw_rad: commanded pocket yaw about env z, rad
columns.pocket_qw: commanded pocket orientation quat_yaw * quat_tilt, wxyz, w >= 0; the tensor that went to write_root_pose_to_sim
columns.pocket_dx_m: commanded pocket position minus its base position, x, ENV frame, m
columns.grasp_obs_x_m: grasp belief error on the OBSERVATION only (D-183), m
columns.friction_cmd: friction _apply_friction commanded; the one-shot D-111 value when the provider carries no friction
columns.friction_robot_min: PhysX read-back, robot, min over shapes and static+dynamic

not_recorded: the six joint-noise columns: their scale is reset_joint_noise_scale_rad above; the realised start pose (IK residual); the per-step observation noise
